g.text: Your eye does not measure light
It samples the spectrum three times.

text.tspan: Everything you will ever see is rebuilt from those three numbers.

g.text: Sensitivity fades out at both ends, and different authorities round the endpoints differently.
Human vision is trichromatic: S, M and L.
Peaks: Bowmaker & Dartnall 1980 · retina counts: NCBI Bookshelf · full curves: Stockman & Sharpe via cvrl.org
